title: Workspace
description: A workspace: the default scope for routing rules and policies.

slug.description: The {workspace} path segment (the `id` works there too). Create-only: on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field. Changing it means replacing the resource.

default_project_id.description: The project a new API key lands in when POST /api-keys names no project_id (the workspace’s default project). Null only for a workspace that has none.
